task:
Create NetworkPolicies in namespace 'project-snake' to restrict egress traffic:

  Setup (run these first):
    kubectl create ns project-snake
    kubectl run backend --image=nginx:1.21 -n project-snake --labels=app=backend
    kubectl run db1 --image=nginx:1.21 -n project-snake --labels=app=db1
    kubectl run db2 --image=nginx:1.21 -n project-snake --labels=app=db2

  Task:
  Create a NetworkPolicy named 'np-backend' in namespace 'project-snake' that:
    - Applies to pods with label: app=backend
    - Allows EGRESS to pods with label app=db1 on port 1111
    - Allows EGRESS to pods with label app=db2 on port 2222
    - Blocks all other egress from backend pods
    - Does NOT restrict ingress (leave ingress open)

  This means policyTypes should only contain 'Egress' (not Ingress).
hints: spec.policyTypes: [Egress] — only restricts egress, ingress remains open
spec.egress is a list — one entry per destination

validators.command: kubectl get networkpolicy np-backend -n {namespace} -o jsonpath='{.spec.egress}' | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)))"
